calls.video_title: Rigetti Stock: Buy the Dip? | RGTI Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: Forward P/E 76 (stated); down 57% YTD 2026, ~80% off ~$50 all-time high
calls.thesis: First tracked call on RGTI: NOT a buying opportunity on this dip — would wait for more progress or a lower price before upgrading to a buy; valuation still expensive after the crash.
calls.base_case: Wait for milestones or a lower price; balance sheet is strong ($383m+ cash vs ~$4m debt) so no near-term need to raise.
calls.bull_case: 95.5% median two-qubit fidelity milestone plus a $100m US government funding agreement; hitting milestones could unlock enterprise use cases and huge revenue growth.
calls.bear_case: Forward P/E 76 vs IonQ at 13.5; revenue lumpy and inconsistent, massive losses (operating cash flow/sales -500%, operating margin -800%); quantum still very early with few enterprise use cases.
